Blade.name: Blade
Blade.summary: The game follows the adventure of Blade with help of his mentor and friend Abraham Whistler. Reviews were mixed, with criticism of the graphics, camera, controls, voice acting, and that the game "failed to capture the spirit" of the movie.

Samurai Kid.name: Samurai Kid
Samurai Kid.summary: Samurai Kid is an Action game, developed by Biox and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2001
